mapper.select: SELECT c.COMPANY_IDX AS company_idx, u.USER_IDX AS users_idx, u.USER_NAME AS user_name, u.LOGIN_ID AS login_id, u.STATUS AS status, c.COMPANY_NUM AS company_num, c.PHONE AS phone, c.ADDRESS AS address, c.EMAIL AS email, NVL(ce.CERT_STATUS, '미등록') AS cert_status FROM USERS u JOIN COMPANY c ON u.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN CERT ce ON ce.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX AND ce.CERT_TYPE = '사업증' WHERE u.USER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' ORDER BY CASE WHEN NVL(ce.CERT_STATUS,'미등록') = '대기' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.USER_IDX DESC

SELECT c.COMPANY_IDX AS company_idx, u.USER_IDX AS users_idx, u.USER_NAME AS user_name, u.LOGIN_ID AS login_id, u.STATUS AS status, c.COMPANY_NUM AS company_num, c.PHONE AS phone, c.ADDRESS AS address, c.EMAIL AS email, NVL(ce.CERT_STATUS, '미등록') AS cert_status,
eu.EMBED_USER_IDX AS embed_user_idx, eu.START_DATE AS start_date, eu.END_DATE AS end_date, eu.REASON AS reason FROM USERS u JOIN COMPANY c ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN CERT ce ON ce.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX AND ce.CERT_TYPE = '사업증' LEFT JOIN EMBEDDED_USER eu ON eu.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX WHERE u.USER_IDX = #{value}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CERT c USING ( SELECT #{usersIdx, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS USER_IDX, #{certType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CERT_TYPE, #{certName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CERT_NAME, #{certStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CERT_STATUS FROM dual ) src ON (c.USER_IDX = src.USER_IDX AND c.CERT_TYPE = src.CERT_TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c.CERT_NAME = src.CERT_NAME, c.CERT_STATUS = src.CERT_STATUS WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CERT_IDX, USER_IDX, CERT_NAME, CERT_TYPE, CERT_STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_CERT.NEXTVAL, src.USER_IDX, src.CERT_NAME, src.CERT_TYPE, src.CERT_STATUS)

MERGE INTO EMBEDDED_USER eu USING ( SELECT #{usersIdx, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS USER_IDX, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AS START_DATE, #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AS END_DATE, #{reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS REASON FROM dual ) src ON (eu.USER_IDX = src.USER_IDX) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET eu.START_DATE = src.START_DATE, eu.END_DATE = src.END_DATE, eu.REASON = src.REASON WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMBED_USER_IDX, USER_IDX, START_DATE, END_DATE, REASON) VALUES (SEQ_EMBED_USER.NEXTVAL, src.USER_IDX, src.START_DATE, src.END_DATE, src.REASON)
